findings.passage: I support concealed carry and I am opposed to banning concealed carry in Colorado. If you support the Second Amendment, and support our right to carry concealed, I encourage you to join me and participate in this process, so your voice is heard.
findings.note: Complete Colorado news story quoting a letter he sent to supporters, as a CU regent, about a proposed change to the university's campus weapons policy. Date is the story's publication date; the letter's own date is not given.

subjects: carry a gun without a ban on concealed carry
places: scope note: per Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_McNulty_(Colorado_politician)) this person served in the state House 2007-2015 and since January 2023 is a University of Colorado regent for the 4th district; no sitting legislator or statewide office and no 2026 ballot entry found
